title: The Castaway's Trail
author: SwedenJohansson
summary: A short adventure: an empty camp, the smuggler's treasure its notes point to, and the rock a warden guards.
description:
Castaway Camp appears ahead as the world starts. Read the notice board and search the supplies: the castaway's notes point to Smuggler's Cove to the north, where a map in a bottle leads to buried treasure. Reach the cove and a flat rock rises to the east - Warden's Rock, and something big guards its top. A wreck drifts by on the way.
Three islands, two quests and a fight. Random islands are off, so these are the only custom islands in the world.
